data.title: Cancellation Policy
data.summary: What you get back when a trip is cancelled, and when. Each listing uses one of three policies, shown before you pay.

highlights.title: Your deposit always comes back
highlights.body: If you cancel before the trip, the refundable deposit is returned in full, whatever the policy.

highlights.title: Full refund until the host accepts
highlights.body: Cancel while your request is still waiting for the host and you get everything back.

highlights.title: Host cancels or declines: full refund
highlights.body: You are never charged for a trip the host does not honour.

highlights.title: Earlier is better
highlights.body: The more notice you give, the more of the trip price you get back.

table.title: Refund of the trip price when a renter cancels a confirmed booking
table.caption: The trip price is everything you paid except the deposit. Notice is counted to the start of your pick-up day (12:00 am, Ghana time).

questions.q: Where do I see which policy applies to my trip?
a: Every listing shows its policy: Flexible, Moderate or Strict. You see it on the listing and again on the review step before you pay. The policy that applied when you booked is the one that applies to your trip, even if the host changes the listing later. Listings use Moderate unless the host chooses otherwise.

questions.q: How do I cancel a booking?
a: Open the trip in Trips and choose Cancel. Cancelling in the app is what counts: a message to the host on its own does not cancel the booking.

questions.q: How is my refund worked out?
a: Your payment has two parts. The refundable deposit, if the listing has one, is always returned in full. The rest, which we call the trip price (rental, service fee and any delivery, insurance or outside-region charge), is refunded in full, by half or not at all, depending on the listing's policy and how much notice you give. The table above shows each case.

questions.q: From when is the notice period counted?
a: From the moment you cancel in the app to the start of your pick-up day, which is 12:00 am Ghana time on the pick-up date, not your pick-up hour. For example, for a pick-up on Saturday, "24 hours before" means before 12:00 am on Friday.

questions.q: Can you show me an example?
a: You book a car on a Moderate policy and pay GHS 1,500: GHS 1,000 trip price and a GHS 500 deposit.

Cancel 5 days before: you get GHS 1,500 back. Cancel 2 days before: you get GHS 1,000 back (the full deposit and half the trip price). Cancel on the morning of pick-up: you get the GHS 500 deposit back.

questions.q: I sent a request but the host has not accepted yet. Can I cancel for free?
a: Yes. Until the host accepts, you can cancel and receive a full refund of everything you paid, whichever policy the listing uses.

questions.q: What if the host declines or does not reply?
a: You are refunded in full automatically. You do not need to do anything.

questions.q: What if the host cancels a booking they already accepted?
a: You receive a full refund, including the deposit, and we will help you find another car. Hosts who cancel confirmed trips may be charged a fee and can be removed from Hayame if it keeps happening.

questions.q: Can I change my dates instead of cancelling?
a: Message the host first. If they are happy with the new dates, contact support before you cancel, so we can help you move the booking without losing money under the cancellation policy. To add days to a trip that is already confirmed, book the extra days as soon as you know, because another renter may take them.

questions.q: I could not complete my identity check in time. Do I lose my money?
a: No. You cannot pay until your identity check is approved, so no money is taken for a booking you were not allowed to make. Your selections are saved and you can finish the booking once you are approved, if the dates are still free.

groups.title: On the day and during the trip

questions.q: What if I do not turn up?
a: A no-show is treated as a cancellation made with less than 24 hours' notice. The same applies if you arrive without your valid driving licence, or if the person who arrives is not the verified renter on the booking, because the host must refuse the handover. Your deposit is still returned.

questions.q: The car is not as described, or the host did not show up. What now?
a: Do not start the trip. Take photos, message the host in the app, and contact support straight away. If the car is unsafe, materially different from the listing, or not made available, you are entitled to a full refund.

questions.q: Can I cancel after the trip has started?
a: A trip that has started cannot be cancelled in the app. If you need to end it early, tell the host and contact support. Unused days are not refunded automatically; any refund depends on the reason and on what the host agrees. If the trip ends early because of a fault with the car that was not your doing, we will help you get a fair refund for the unused days.

questions.q: What about things nobody can control, like serious illness, flooding or a road closure?
a: Tell the host and contact support as early as you can, with whatever proof you have. We look at these cases one by one and will ask the host to agree to a fair outcome. The standard policy applies unless we confirm otherwise.

questions.q: How and when will I receive my refund?
a: Refunds go back to the payment method you used, through Paystack. We send the refund as soon as the cancellation is confirmed. Mobile money refunds usually arrive quickly; card and bank refunds can take up to 10 working days to show, depending on your bank. You will receive an email receipt for every refund.

questions.q: Is the Hayame service fee refunded?
a: The service fee is part of the trip price, so it is refunded in the same proportion: in full with a full refund, by half with a half refund.

questions.q: My refund has not arrived. What should I do?
a: Check the refund receipt email for the date and reference, then allow the time above. If it still has not arrived, contact support with the booking reference and we will trace it with Paystack.

questions.q: Which policy should I choose for my listing?
a: Flexible attracts the most bookings and suits cars that are easy to re-book. Moderate is the balanced default. Strict gives you the most certainty and suits high-demand cars or long trips, but some renters will choose another car. You set the policy when you create or edit a listing.

questions.q: What do I receive when a renter cancels?
a: The part of the trip price that is not refunded to the renter stays with the booking and is paid out to you in the usual way, less Hayame's fee. If the renter receives a full refund, there is no payout for that booking.

questions.q: What happens if I have to cancel?
a: Cancel in the app as early as possible and message the renter. The renter is refunded in full. Because a cancelled trip can leave someone stranded, repeated host cancellations affect your standing and can lead to fees or removal. If you cancel because the renter broke the rules, for example the wrong person arrived, tell support so it is not counted against you.

data.contact: Questions about a cancellation or refund? Use Help in the app or email support@hayamegh.com with your booking reference.
